name: Evaluate whether teaching changed performance
short_description: Evaluate whether teaching changed performance once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can evaluate whether teaching changed performance in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Evaluate whether teaching changed performance means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Evaluate whether teaching changed performance in a fresh real-life scenario.
